name: JW Marriott Guanacaste Resort & Spa
positioning: Hacienda-style beach resort (officially JW Marriott Guanacaste Beach Resort) on Playa Mansita within Hacienda Pinilla, a short ride from Tamarindo
best_for: Beach lovers who want oceanfront suites a few steps from the sand
Active travelers who want horseback riding, bike trails and beach yoga
Families with children who can join the Family by JW program

facts.text: The resort is a short ride from the town of Tamarindo.
The resort is surrounded by dry scrub forest, riding stables, an 18-hole golf course and howler monkeys.
The resort's design evokes a Spanish hacienda.
Hammock-lined courtyards bordered by outdoor passageways divide the large hotel into intimate spaces.
The resort's beach is set within a natural bay.
The outdoor pool is lagoon-shaped with an infinity edge.
Some suite types have a plunge pool.
Spa treatments incorporate local plants and minerals.
Four bicycle trails lead through the natural reserve.
Yoga classes take place on the private beach or on terraces overlooking the ocean.
Children can join the Family by JW program.
Azul is a beachfront restaurant with panoramic views of the Pacific Ocean.

highlights.text: The resort sits on the shores of Playa Mansita within Hacienda Pinilla.
The spa has treatment rooms with outdoor tubs.
The oceanfront suites are a few steps from the sand.
Horseback riding is led by Costa Rican cowboys, called sabaneros.
A romantic four-course candlelight dinner is set on a private corner of the white sand beach.

considerations.text: The closest airport is Daniel Oduber Quiros International (LIR), approximately 74.8 km from the resort.
